kaikki_vikisozluk.e: تَمَشْدَقَ • (tamašdaqa) IIq (non-past يَتَمَشْدَقُ (yatamašdaqu), verbal noun تَمَشْدُق (tamašduq))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: From the root م ش د ق (m š d q), from شِدْق (šidq, “corners of the mouth or jaw”).
s: م ش د ق (m š d q)
g: to speak in an excessively eloquent manner.
